title: [AUG-213] Server: store a source anchor and a context summary for every action item
why_we_need_this:
Action items are stored as a bare title plus owner, so the user cannot tell what "Присылайте документы" or "Предложить вам идею" refers to and has to dig through the transcript. Research AUG-211 (@docs/mockups/AUG-211/findings.md) found the cause: live lines have no timestamp and the extraction call drops the link to the source lines, so `ActionItem` has nothing to point back with.

This task makes the server keep, for every item, where it came from (time, speaker, verbatim quote) and a one-sentence summary written in the same Groq extraction call (option A of the research: no extra model calls). It is the data layer for the UI in the client task and for the Praxis export, transcript.md and the august MCP. Without it the approved mockup (@docs/mockups/AUG-211/action-item-context.html) cannot be built.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] `ActionItem` has optional `context` (<= 240 chars) and `anchor` (`kind: 'said' | 'added'`, `atMs`, `speaker`, `quote` <= 400 chars, `lineIds` <= 3, `line`); `ActionItemLock` has `context`; `ActionItemsFile` has optional `recordingStartedAt`; `version` stays 1 and a file written before this task still loads with all its items (test).
- [ ] `sanitizeActionItemsFile` keeps valid new fields and drops malformed ones without dropping the item (test).
- [ ] The client sends `recordingStartedAt` in `action-items-init` for both the Live and the meeting-only socket; every live line gets a start time = chunk arrival time minus chunk duration, and `anchor.atMs` is that time relative to `recordingStartedAt` (test with a fake clock).
- [ ] Both extraction prompts number the `context` and `transcript` entries and ask for `lines` per new item; the server builds `anchor.quote`, `speaker`, `atMs` and `lineIds` from its own buffer, never from model text; invalid or missing numbers give an anchor with the time of the first sent line and no quote (tests for both cases).
- [ ] The Groq prompt also returns `context` (one sentence, meeting language, only facts that were said, empty when the title needs nothing); the local prompt does not ask for `context`; a Groq-extracted item in a test fixture gets a non-empty context, a locally extracted one gets a quote and no context.
- [ ] The number of Groq calls per session is unchanged: no new call site is added, `cloudCallPending` and the corrector yield (AUG-167) behave as before (existing tests pass).
- [ ] Merge: the survivor keeps its own anchor and context and takes the removed item's only when it has none and `context` is not locked; delete ops are still dropped; the 0.6 similarity guard is unchanged (tests).
- [ ] `PATCH /api/sessions/:id/action-items/:itemId` and the `action-item-edit` frame accept `context` and set `locked.context`; editing text or owner leaves anchor and context untouched (tests).
- [ ] A live correction of a line (AUG-164) replaces that line inside the quote of items that reference its id while the recording is live (test).
- [ ] Manual and assistant items created during a recording get `anchor {kind: 'added', atMs}`, including in a Default-mode recording without Live Text (AUG-200); august MCP `add_action_item` accepts an optional `context` (<= 240 chars).
- [ ] When transcript.md is written (first transcription and re-transcription) every anchor gets `line` = utterance index: best stem overlap with the quote within ±45 s of `atMs` (same speaker when the transcript has roles), otherwise the nearest line at or before `atMs`; `lineIds` are removed when the store moves into the session folder (tests incl. re-transcription).
- [ ] transcript.md "## Action items": an item with context gets one indented sub-line `  - Context: <summary> ([HH:MM:SS])`; items without context render exactly as today (test).
- [ ] Praxis separate card: the description has a `## Context` block (summary, `Said by <name> at HH:MM:SS`, quote) before the transcript, and the whole transcript is still attached; the common card lists summaries in the description and keeps the checklist lines unchanged (tests).
- [ ] august MCP `list_action_items` returns `context`, `said_at` (HH:MM:SS) and `quote` when present.
- [ ] The Groq text consent modal and the route docs say that action items are saved with a short quote of the moment they were said; the invariant "live text is never saved" in @project-context/transcription/live-transcription/README.md is reworded accordingly.
- [ ] `npm test` passes for the server; quotes, contexts and transcript text are never written to logs.
important_constraints:
- Order: 1/3. Blocks: AUG-214-sn2yg3 (client UI), AUG-215-57bit6 (audio playback). Research: AUG-211-yw2f5w.
- Design source: @docs/mockups/AUG-211/findings.md sections 2–5 (anchor model, survival rules, storage/API). Follow it; if something there cannot be implemented as written, stop and ask.
- No new Groq or local model calls; `maxTokens` of the cloud extraction may rise from 600 to 900. Action items keep priority over line correction (AUG-167).
- Models never delete action items; no model operation writes `context` or `anchor` after the item is created; locked fields are never changed by a model.
- Nothing new is sent to Groq beyond line numbers: later calls still send items as `{id, text, owner}` only.
- Cross-platform: `liveTranscription.ts` is a shared high-risk file — no platform branches, no platform-specific paths; the change must behave the same on Windows and macOS.
- Uploads and recovery uploads without a liveKey stay without items — unchanged.
- No UI work here except sending `recordingStartedAt` from the client and the one consent sentence.
